query: I planted a new batch of mint on my balcony yesterday, and it already smells so lovely every time I open the sliding door. I tried making iced mint lemonade with some of the older leaves this afternoon, it turned out way sweeter than I expected even without adding extra honey. My cat was super curious about the new plant too, she kept sniffing the pot and trying to bat at the leaves until I gently moved it out of her reach. Anyway, I'm having some issues with my mobile data right now: I have airplane mode turned on, my network preference settings seem off, the VPN I use isn't working properly, my data mode is disabled, I've exceeded my data usage limit, I'm currently abroad and roaming is turned off, and I can't get any internet connection to work at all.
